name: Argo Corporation
summary: Argo Corporation provides technology-enabled transit solutions in Canada. The company offers Argo Transit, a platform that offers municipalities a full service, electrified, and scalable transit solution, which Argo Transit has been deployed can use the Argo app to request trips at or near door for a standard transit fare. It also provides Argo School, a platform to serve the student transportation market. The company was formerly known as Steer Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Argo Corporation in July 2024. Argo Corporation was founded in 2016 is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
